title: Fynaptix · Quantum Computing Research
heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S ~54–419×), are funding themselves with heavy dilution and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Quantum technologies market projection; a Benchmark analyst puts 2026 industry revenue at only ~$1.5B, and Morgan Stanley projects a $100B market by 2040.

Pure-plays sold off hard after IonQ announced an all-stock Elisity acquisition (up to $1.3B, Oct 12) and a $2B equity raise (Oct 14), on top of hot CPI (3.7%), a 10-year yield above 5% and a ~4.5% Nasdaq weekly drop. Oct 9→Oct 16 closes: IonQ $39.89→$31.28 (−22%), Rigetti $14.03→$11.80 (−16%), D-Wave $14.57→$11.78 (−19%), Quantinuum $41.30→$36.55 (−11%), Pasqal $6.85→$5.67 (−17%), QTUM $152.06→$137.14 (−10%).

IonQ's $2B offering of shares and pre-funded warrants to a single institutional buyer (one source cites a ~$40 price; another says it priced below recent trading) follows an all-stock Elisity deal with an issue-price collar of $33.07–$49.61. Shares outstanding are already ~429M versus 405M before. FY26 revenue guidance remains $450–460M including SkyWater; Q2 revenue was $80.05M (+287% YoY).

IonQ $31.28 (~$13.43B mkt cap / $246.5M TTM revenue, P/S ~54×) / Rigetti $11.80 (~$3.94B / $13.35M, ~295×) / D-Wave $11.78 (~$4.39B / $12.43M, ~353×) / Quantinuum $36.55 (~$9.62B / $22.97M, ~419×); Pasqal $5.67 (~$1.20B mkt cap); Defiance Quantum ETF (QTUM) $137.14 (~$5.37B AUM), 19% below its 52-week high of $170. Ratios are computed from market cap and TTM revenue.

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: DARPA QBI Stage C (since Oct 7) is now backed by the Oct 8 Pentagon package: ~$200M in new DARPA funding across the four new Stage C teams (IBM, IonQ, Atom Computing, Diraq). Builds on Nighthawk r2 and Anderon CHIPS foundry funding
rows.watch for: Stage C award size for IBM (not disclosed); Albany 300mm foundry yield ramp; progress against the 2029 fault-tolerant Starling roadmap

rows.angle: No new hardware headline since the Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone; still a lab result, and Google is not in DARPA Stage C
rows.watch for: Scaling stable logical qubits into larger arrays; any commercial Willow-class access; overlap with your AI-sleeve Alphabet exposure

rows.angle: Majorana 2 remains with DARPA for independent testing at the new Maryland center; Microsoft and PsiQuantum have been in QBI Stage C since before the Oct 7 additions
rows.watch for: Independent test results on the topological-qubit claims; Quantinuum partnership developments

rows.angle: Oct 8: $1B five-year US science commitment (AI, quantum, healthcare, energy) and Genesis Mission collaborator; CUDA-Q and NVQLink tie quantum hardware to GPU systems. Hit by the broader tech selloff this week
rows.watch for: How much of the $1B reaches quantum; new NVQLink adopters; quantum remains immaterial to NVIDIA's revenue

tiers.label: Pure-Plays — Highly Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: Oct 12: all-stock Elisity deal (up to $1.3B, incl. up to $150M earnout; zero-trust security) and Oct 14: $2B equity raise; shares fell to $31.28 (−22% on the week, −58% from the $73.87 high). Offsets: DARPA Stage C (up to $300M through 2029, subject to appropriations), Cambridge innovation centre opened, FY26 guidance $450–460M
rows.watch for: Elisity close (Q4) and share issuance within the $33.07–$49.61 collar; how the $2B is deployed; SkyWater integration and organic vs inorganic mix; ~54× TTM P/S

rows.watch for: Dilution from the government stake and any ATM raise; 108-qubit system progress; ~295× P/S; sits just above its $11.11 52-week low

rows.watch for: Whether deliveries convert to bookings; CFO transition (retirement announced Aug 26); ~353× P/S

rows.watch for: Whether the 'Sol' system proves scalability in 2027; IPO lockup expiries; ~419× TTM P/S; $33.02 52-week low

rows.angle: Fell to $5.67 (−17% on the week), at its $5.55 52-week low and ~77% below the $24.69 high; launched an AI-assisted cloud QPU workflow (Oct 8); TTM revenue ~27.8M (reported in EUR) up ~66%

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: In DARPA QBI Stage C with Microsoft ($125M award Jul 23, up to $300M) and finalized a $100M CHIPS R&D award on Sep 8. On Oct 8 the Pentagon package added a conditional loan of up to $150M from the Office of Strategic Capital for its Milpitas, California hub; final commitment depends on conditions. Valued around $10.5B privately (~$1.5B round, May 2026).

private_watchlist.name: Atom Computing
private_watchlist.note: Joined QBI Stage C on Oct 7 alongside IBM, IonQ and Diraq; no listed security, so it is only a read-across for neutral-atom peers such as Pasqal and Infleqtion.

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: Previously reported 96 verified logical qubits and a DARPA QBI Stage B slot (not re-verified this week); not among the Stage C names. Infleqtion (INFQ, ~$8.55, near its 52-week low) received ~£9M from Innovate UK this week for a quantum RF direction-finding system.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: IonQ's ~$13.4B market cap sits on $246.5M of trailing revenue and roughly half of its FY26 guidance is inorganic (SkyWater). D-Wave's trailing revenue is $12.43M, down 44% YoY; Quantinuum booked about $8M last quarter, with ~$30M expected for 2026.

bear_case.title: Dilution is now the dominant story
bear_case.description: IonQ raised $2B in equity on Oct 14 two days after agreeing an all-stock Elisity deal of up to $1.3B, taking shares outstanding from ~405M toward 430M+ before the pre-funded warrants and deal shares. Commerce also holds minority equity stakes alongside $100M CHIPS awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum. The market treated the raise as a signal to sell the whole group.

bear_case.title: Rates and macro are the swing factor
bear_case.description: September CPI ran 3.7%, the 10-year yield stayed above 5%, and markets price about a 40% chance of another Fed hike at the Oct 27–28 meeting. The Nasdaq fell ~4.5% last week; QTUM fell ~10% and pre-revenue long-duration names fell 11–22%.

bear_case.title: Drawdowns remain brutal
bear_case.description: IonQ is ~58% below its 52-week high, Rigetti sits just above its $11.11 low (high $55.16), D-Wave is within ~4% of its $11.35 low (high $45.13), Quantinuum is ~58% below its post-IPO high and Pasqal is ~77% below its high.

bear_case.title: The winner may not be listed or pure-play
bear_case.description: Microsoft, IBM, PsiQuantum, Atom Computing and Diraq sit in QBI Stage C alongside IonQ; PsiQuantum, Atom and Diraq are private and two are giants where quantum is a rounding error. Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum are not on the list. DARPA's 'up to $300M' is a ceiling subject to appropriations, and headline milestones can oversell (Infleqtion's 30 logical qubits rely on error detection, not correction).

catalysts.title: Morgan Stanley upgrades Quantinuum to Overweight, $62 target
catalysts.description: Cites the lead in error-correction technology and the lowest EV multiple on 2030 revenue; shares jumped ~11% on the day to ~$36.6 but the week still ended lower. Same session, IonQ fell ~9% to $31.28.

catalysts.title: IonQ prices a $2B equity offering
catalysts.description: Shares and pre-funded warrants sold to a single institutional buyer; dilution fears hit the whole group, with Rigetti and D-Wave each down ~4% on the day.

catalysts.title: IonQ to acquire Elisity for up to $1.3B in stock
catalysts.description: Zero-trust cybersecurity deal expected to close in Q4 2026, with the share issue price collared between $33.07 and $49.61 and up to $150M of earnouts; IonQ fell ~9%.

catalysts.title: Pentagon announces ~$350M quantum push
catalysts.description: About $200M of new DARPA funding tied to the four new Stage C teams, a conditional loan of up to $150M to PsiQuantum from the Office of Strategic Capital, and DARPA application workshops before January 2027. Same day NVIDIA committed $1B over five years to US science.

catalysts.title: DARPA adds IonQ, IBM, Atom Computing and Diraq to QBI Stage C
catalysts.description: IonQ's agreement is worth up to $300M through 2029, subject to appropriations; Microsoft and PsiQuantum were already in Stage C.

catalysts.title: Federal Reserve meeting (upcoming)
catalysts.description: Markets price roughly a 40% chance of another quarter-point hike; rates have been the main driver of quantum multiple compression.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: Stage C since Oct 7 now sits under the Oct 8 Pentagon package (~$200M new DARPA money across four teams) with the Albany 300mm foundry and Anderon CHIPS funding, at a valuation that does not depend on quantum.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone is still a top technical result among hedged names, though Google is not in Stage C; also a large AI-sleeve holding, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: In DARPA Stage C and Majorana 2 is under independent DARPA testing, but the topological claims are still contested; MSFT also sits in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: Picks-and-shovels via CUDA-Q and NVQLink plus a $1B five-year US science pledge (Oct 8); quantum is immaterial to revenue and it is also in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: DARPA Stage C (up to $300M) and $450–460M guidance are real, but a $2B raise plus a $1.3B stock deal in three days, a 22% weekly drop to $31.28 and ~54x sales cut the weight from 13% to 8%.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: $11.80 and ~295x sales on $13.35M of TTM revenue, just above its $11.11 low; the $100M CHIPS award brings a government equity stake and it is not in Stage C.

positions.name: Quantinuum
positions.note: Morgan Stanley's Oct 16 Overweight ($62 target) rates its error-correction lead above IonQ's, but ~419x trailing sales and ~$8M quarterly revenue mean small size only.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Trailing revenue of $12.43M is down 44% YoY against a ~$4.39B market cap; the Italy delivery and SkyWater extension do not change the case.

positions.name: Pasqal
positions.note: At its $5.55 low after a 17% weekly drop and ~77% below its high, with no reported quarter yet as a listed company; wait for results.
